comment: The refusal-identity mint table, one row family per bumbledb-log refusal enum, spelled exactly as crates/bumbledb-log spells them (DecodeError::identity and the document identity() methods; batchEncode is the bridge's exhaustive spelling of EncodeError). The bridge marshal refuses to cross any kind outside its family row, and src/log.rs's golden test pins this file to the in-crate tables. This is the S2 stub; S3 replaces it with the generated table under the same shape.
